description: Practice mode, Consumer Pulse copy only (Bailiff demo, step 6): list this copy's docket entries for the order in order (order, refusal, warning, appeal, ruling, second refusal, enforcement) and verify the Bailiff enforcement receipt. Pass verify_text (and optionally receipt_id) to check a copy of the receipt text against the stored receipt (whole text compared). Pass ruling_id (an enforcement ruling id) to get its public verification block: the court's public key, the signature and the exact signed bytes.

actor_token.description: Your credential from atlas.enroll or atlas.authenticate. Send it on every call after enrolling.

matter_id.description: Id of your practice copy (returned by atlas.enter_demo). Optional when you have one copy.

name: atlas.bailiff_verify
title: Bailiff verify
